title: Pin Tudung Pukul Enam
subject: a husband learning to pin his wife's tudung neatly every morning before her 7 a.m. shift because her right wrist is in a plaster cast, practising on a pillow the night before
caption: Malay power-ballad duet in the modern Malaysia-Indonesia crossover style. Grand piano playing broad sustained chords, clean arpeggiated electric guitar with chorus, warm string pad swelling into the chorus, live drums entering in the second verse with a big reverbed snare, fretless bass. Wide polished studio ballad mix. Male tenor and female mezzo duet, trading verses then harmonising on the chorus. 72 BPM, Eb major. Tender, devoted and quietly funny. No autotune, no trap hi-hats, no EDM drop, no dangdut drums, no rap.
lyrics:
[Intro - grand piano and string pad]

[Verse 1 - Male Vocal]
Tangan awak bersimen putih
Pukul enam belum siap
Malam tadi abang berlatih
Pin tudung atas bantal

[Verse 2 - Female Vocal]
Abang cucuk senget sikit
Saya ketawa depan cermin
Jari abang besar, kasar
Tapi sabar, tak pernah marah

[Pre-Chorus]
Jangan gerak, tahan nafas
Satu pin lagi, dah nak lepas

[Chorus - Duet]
Pukul enam, depan cermin
Abang pin tudung awak
Tak lawa macam kedai
Tapi abang buat dengan hati

[Bridge - piano alone, then drums return]
Enam minggu simen tu
Abang dah mahir sekarang

[Chorus - Duet]
Pukul enam, depan cermin
Abang pin tudung awak
Bila simen dah dibuka
Boleh abang buat lagi?

[Outro - piano and guitar, soft fade]
